GraphChoices.exists_preprocessed_split.label: Bipartite preprocessing
GraphChoices.exists_preprocessed_split.summary: Splits the original graph into a bipartite graph with a controlled left degree.

GraphChoices.Peeling.exists_skew_biregul.label: Graph decomposition
GraphChoices.Peeling.exists_skew_biregul.summary: Partitions the graph into pieces with controlled degrees at doubly exponential scales.

GraphChoices.Patterns.concrete_component.label: Residual component tail
GraphChoices.Patterns.concrete_component.summary: Bounds the probability that Threshold-Greedy leaves a large residual component by 3/Nᶜ.

GraphChoices.Peeling.exists_rate_competi.label: Rate-adapted policy
GraphChoices.Peeling.exists_rate_competi.summary: Constructs a competitive online policy using thresholds adapted to the arrival rate.

GraphChoices.Peeling.exists_bipartite_po.label: All arrival horizons
GraphChoices.Peeling.exists_bipartite_po.summary: Combines the short, intermediate, and long horizon cases for bipartite graphs.

GraphChoices.mainTheorem.label:
Theorem 1.1
Online upper bound
GraphChoices.mainTheorem.summary: Proves an O(log log n) competitive deterministic online policy for every nonempty simple graph and every horizon.

GraphChoices.LowerBound.goodBatches_maxL.label: Greedy load propagation
GraphChoices.LowerBound.goodBatches_maxL.summary: Shows that successful batches force Greedy load to grow through the layered graph.

GraphChoices.LowerBound.expectedGreedy_l.label: Expected Greedy load
GraphChoices.LowerBound.expectedGreedy_l.summary: Uses the batch failure probability to obtain a lower bound on expected Greedy load.

GraphChoices.LowerBound.family_optimum_b.label: Offline optimum bound
GraphChoices.LowerBound.family_optimum_b.summary: Bounds the expected offline optimum of the explicit graph family by 500 log(b + 1).

GraphChoices.LowerBound.family_competiti.label: Competitive gap
GraphChoices.LowerBound.family_competiti.summary: Combines the Greedy load lower bound with the offline optimum upper bound.

GraphChoices.LowerBound.family_degree_ra.label: Degree bounds
GraphChoices.LowerBound.family_degree_ra.summary: Places every vertex degree between sqrt(N) and sqrt(N) log(N)³.

GraphChoices.LowerBound.greedyLowerBound.label:
Theorem 1.2
Greedy lower bound
GraphChoices.LowerBound.greedyLowerBound.summary: Constructs arbitrarily large simple graphs where fair-tie Greedy has competitive ratio at least log(N)/(30000 (log log(N))²).
